_about: Every web page Chalk links to or relies on, in one place, so a maintainer can update a link without touching the code (sponsor, Nov 9). Change a 'url' here to change it for everyone who installs this copy of Chalk. An instructor can also change a link for their own computer under Settings -> More settings; that is saved in 'Chalk links.json' in their Chalk Courses folder and wins over this file. Keep each 'key' as it is: the code looks links up by key.

links.label: University of Utah academic calendars
links.used_for: Where the term dates and breaks in resources/data/calendars.json come from. Check it each term and add the next year's terms.

links.label: University of Utah class schedule
links.used_for: Lists each section's meeting days, times, and room. Rollover links to it so instructors can look up the new term's room.

links.label: Canvas student guides
links.used_for: Linked from the help section of the Canvas syllabus page Chalk writes.

links.label: Center for Disability & Access
links.used_for: Linked from the accessibility section of the Canvas syllabus page Chalk writes.
